thread:
claire: Quick design check on stacktrace list — need decisions on keyboard shortcuts, export placement, and copy/permalink affordances. Figma: https://figma.redwood/app/stacktrace-shortcuts.

maddie: My vote: bulk export in page toolbar (CSV default), keep per-row export hidden in kebab. Add small copy icon next to correlation id that always copies full id.

eli: If we add keyboard shortcuts, scope them to the focused list (e.g., when a row is selected): 'E' = export focused rows, 'Shift+C' = copy correlation id. Avoid global bindings. Announce state with a sr-only live region ("Export ready").

tim: Implementation notes: icon button aria-label="Copy correlation id"; make touch target >=44px and provide visible hover/active states. For copy feedback use aria-live="polite" role="status" and a transient tooltip "Copied". Truncate ids visually (first 8 chars + …) but make aria-label the full id so screen readers get full value.

jyoti: A11y checklist: contrast for id pill >=4.5:1, focus ring clearly visible (3px), keyboard order must be: row checkbox -> permalink -> id -> copy -> kebab. For copy failures announce "Copy failed, use Ctrl+C" and show an inline toast.

claire: Filename for exports: errors-YYYYMMDD.csv (or .jsonl). Include a small header row with schema version: "X-Schema: v1" to help backwards compatibility. Mobile note: long-press selection should not conflict with our copy button; tapping id should open drilldown.

ux-bot: Reminder: attach keyboard walkthrough and contrast report to design PR before Friday. :spiral_calendar:
